mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_run (run_id, task_id, lease_token, run_status, worker_id) VALUES (#{runId}, #{taskId}, #{leaseToken}, 'RUNNING', #{workerId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE lease_token = VALUES(lease_token), worker_id = VALUES(worker_id), run_status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_run SET run_status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE run_id = #{runId}
